goal: Expose the node's chain interface over IPC sockets
Allows separate processes like the wallet to query chain state and receive block notifications
reviewability: Author has not replied to an open crash report for 15 days (zaidmstrr)
agreement: Broad support for socket-based IPC to separate wallet processes and external tooling
Verified by testing against a Rust wallet implementation and Electrs demo (darosior, Sjors)
Unaddressed objection: node aborts when getBlockHash is called beyond the chain tip (zaidmstrr)
Answered objection: risk of node segfault on null transaction data over IPC (willcl-ark)

categories.name: ipc
why: P1 because it is required to run the wallet in a separate process in #10102
Foundational step for separating node services and enabling out-of-process integrations
